definition_zh: 疗法；药物；解决办法；补救；法律救济
definition_en: a cure for an illness, or a way of dealing with a problem
core_image: 病人端起一碗苦药，喝下去之后脸色慢慢转好
scene: 山里没有医院，老人用一种草根煎水给发烧的孩子退热。In the mountain village, the grandmother used a bitter herb as a remedy for fever.
sceneCN: 这里 remedy 是「疗法、药物」（第 1 个义项：治病的方法）；句意：在山村里，祖母用一种苦味的草药作为退烧的疗法。

pos.zh: 疗法；药物；解决办法；法律救济
补救；纠正

collocations.zh: 治疗……的方法；解决……的办法

derivatives.zh: remedy 加 -ial 构成，义为「补救的；补习的」
由拉丁语 remediare 重构的动词，义为「治理；修复」
remediate 加 -ion 构成，义为「补救；治理」

senses.title: A cure for an illness
senses.definition: a medicine or treatment that cures or eases a disease or a bad condition
senses.definitionCN: 治愈或缓解疾病与不良状况的药物或治疗方法
senses.example: Honey and lemon is an old remedy for a sore throat.
senses.exampleCN: 蜂蜜柠檬是治喉咙痛的古老偏方。
senses.why: The Latin word combines re- with mederi, to heal, so the core picture is something that heals a body back.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 remedium 是「治疗的手段」，所以最核心的画面就是能让人恢复的东西。

senses.title: A way of dealing with a problem
senses.definition: an action that corrects or improves a bad situation
senses.definitionCN: 纠正或改善不良局面的行动
senses.example: There is no simple remedy for traffic in the city centre.
senses.exampleCN: 市中心的交通问题没有简单的解决办法。
senses.why: If healing can restore a body, it can also restore a situation, which gives the general sense of a fix.
senses.whyCN: 身体可以治好，坏掉的局面同样可以「治好」，词义由此扩展到一般的问题。

senses.title: A legal or official form of relief
senses.definition: a legal means by which a person can put right a wrong done to them
senses.definitionCN: 当事人用以纠正其所受侵害的法律手段
senses.example: The tenant asked the court for a remedy.
senses.exampleCN: 租客向法院请求法律救济。
senses.why: Law borrows the healing image: the court restores a wronged party the way medicine restores the sick.
senses.whyCN: 法律把受损害的一方恢复原状，思路与药物恢复病人身体完全一致。

senses.title: To put something right
senses.definition: to correct a fault or make a bad situation better
senses.definitionCN: 纠正错误，或使糟糕的局面好转
senses.example: The company must remedy the fault within thirty days.
senses.exampleCN: 公司必须在三十天内修正这个缺陷。
senses.why: The noun sense turns back into a verb, naming the act of applying the cure to a fault.
senses.whyCN: 名词义回到动词义，指把疗法施加到缺陷上的那个动作。

intro.en: Remedy comes from Latin remedium, built from re- and mederi, to heal, the same root as medicine.
intro.cn: remedy 来自拉丁语 remedium，由 re- 与 mederi「治疗」构成，与 medicine 同根。

items.en: Mederi means to heal or cure, and gives the med- family of medicine and medical.
items.cn: mederi 意为治疗、治愈，产生了 medicine 与 medical 这一组 med- 词族。

items.en: Remedium adds re- to mederi and names a means of healing.
items.cn: remedium 在 mederi 前加 re-，指治疗的手段。

items.en: Old French remedie carries both the medical and the general sense of a fix.
items.cn: 古法语 remedie 同时带有医学义与一般的「解决办法」义。

items.en: English remedy first names a medicine or a treatment.
items.cn: 英语 remedy 最初指药物或疗法。

items.en: Law adopts the word for a formal means of correcting a wrong.
items.cn: 十五世纪，法律采用这个词，指纠正侵害的正式手段。

items.en: The verb use, to remedy a fault, becomes common in official and technical writing.
items.cn: 作动词表示「补救缺陷」的用法在官方与技术文本中变得常见。

note.en: Remedy shares its root with medicine and medical, and it stands near words for cures and for fixes.
note.cn: remedy 与 medicine、medical 共享词根，与表示疗法和修补的词相邻。

entries.definition: intended to correct or improve something
entries.definitionCN: 补救的；补习的，由 remedy 加 -ial 构成

entries.definition: a substance used to treat illness
entries.definitionCN: 药；医学，与 remedy 共享 mederi 词根

entries.definition: relating to the treatment of illness
entries.definitionCN: 医学的，与 remedy 共享 mederi 词根

entries.definition: a treatment that makes an illness go away completely
entries.definitionCN: 治愈；疗法，语气比 remedy 更强

entries.definition: medical care given for an illness
entries.definitionCN: 治疗；处理，范围最宽

entries.definition: a way of dealing with a problem
entries.definitionCN: 解决办法，与 remedy 的第二义项接近

normalIntro.en: The med- root of healing runs through remedy, medicine, and medical, which makes the family easy to hold.
normalIntro.cn: 表示「治疗」的 med- 词根贯穿 remedy、medicine、medical，使这一族词很好掌握。

normal.en: Re- plus mederi, to heal, gives something that heals back to health.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 mederi「治疗」，就是把人治回健康的东西。

normal.en: Medicine and medical share the identical med- root.
normal.cn: medicine 与 medical 共享完全相同的 med- 词根。

normal.en: Change the y to i before -es, -ed, and -ing: remedies, remedied, remedying.
normal.cn: 在 -es、-ed、-ing 前把 y 变成 i：remedies、remedied、remedying。

normal.en: The pattern a remedy for something works for both illness and problems.
normal.cn: a remedy for something 这个句型既可用于疾病，也可用于问题。

normal.en: Remedial classes are meant to fix gaps in learning.
normal.cn: remedial classes 指用来弥补学习缺口的补习课。

abstract.en: Picture a bowl of dark herbal tea steaming on a low table.
abstract.cn: 想象矮桌上冒着热气的一碗深色草药汤。

abstract.en: See a cracked wall being filled and smoothed by a careful hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一只有经验的手把裂开的墙填补抹平。

abstract.en: Think of a judge handing down a decision that repairs a loss.
abstract.cn: 想一位法官作出裁决，把损失弥补回来。

examples.en: The best remedy for a cold is rest and warm drinks.
examples.cn: 治感冒最好的办法是休息和喝热饮。

examples.en: The government promised to remedy the shortage of housing.
examples.cn: 政府承诺解决住房短缺问题。

examples.en: Consumers have the right to seek a legal remedy.
examples.cn: 消费者有权寻求法律救济。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞美地」——想象瑞丽美丽的地方出产良药，病人在那里痊愈；只是谐音联想，并非词源。

root: 拉丁语 remedium，由 re-（回、再）与 mederi（治疗）构成，与 medicine、medical 同根。

sensesIntro.en: Healing a body, fixing a situation, repairing a legal wrong, and the act of putting things right all hang on one image of cure.
sensesIntro.cn: 治愈身体、修复局面、纠正法律侵害，以及「把事弄好」这个动作，都挂在同一个「治愈」的画面上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: bitter medicine taken and colour returning to the face.
core.cn: 核心意象：喝下苦药，脸色慢慢恢复血色。

branches.en: The medical cure is the oldest and most physical sense.
branches.cn: 医学上的治疗是最古老、最具体的义项。

branches.en: A broken situation can be healed too, which widens the word.
branches.cn: 破掉的局面同样可以「治」，词义由此扩大。

branches.en: The law repairs a wrong as medicine repairs a body.
branches.cn: 法律修复侵害，正如药物修复身体。

branches.en: The verb names the act of applying the cure.
branches.cn: 动词义指把疗法施加于问题的动作。

branches.en: All three noun senses depend on the same metaphor of restoration.
branches.cn: 三个名词义项都依赖同一个「恢复」的比喻。

intro.en: Remedy is a compact Latin word in which a prefix and a healing root do all the work.
intro.cn: remedy 是一个紧凑的拉丁词，前缀与表示治疗的词根承担了全部表意功能。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- adds the idea of back or again, and mederi supplies the healing, so the whole means a means of healing back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 带来「回、再」的意思，mederi 提供「治疗」，整体即「把人治回去的手段」。

items.example: Re- suggests restoring a former state.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 暗示恢复到先前的状态。

items.example: The med- root also appears in medicine and medical.
items.exampleCN: med- 词根也出现在 medicine 与 medical 中。

items.example: Mederi is the healing verb behind the root.
items.exampleCN: mederi 是这个词根背后的治疗动词。

items.meaningCN: 表示事物或结果的名词词尾
items.example: The final -y marks the noun remedy.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -y 标记名词 remedy。

items.example: Remedial means relating to a remedy.
items.exampleCN: remedial 意为「与补救有关的」。

items.meaning: a cure, a means of healing
items.example: Remedium is the direct Latin source.
items.exampleCN: remedium 是直接的拉丁来源。

items.example: Medical and remedy share the same med- root.
items.exampleCN: medical 与 remedy 共享同一个 med- 词根。

items.meaning: the act of correcting a problem
items.example: Remediation is used for cleaning up polluted land.
items.exampleCN: remediation 常用于指受污染土地的治理。

补救；治理

definition_zh: 记得；想起；记住去做；代问好；纪念
definition_en: to keep something in your mind or bring it back into your mind
core_image: 多年后仍能准确说出那天的天气和气味
scene: 多年以后，她还能说出那家小店门口挂着什么颜色的帘子。Years later, she could still remember the colour of the curtain at the shop door.
sceneCN: 这里 remember 是「记得」（第 1 个义项：把过去的经历保存在心里并能想起）；句意：多年以后，她仍然记得那家店门口帘子的颜色。

pos.zh: 记得；想起；记住；纪念
记得；回忆起

derivatives.zh: remember 加 -ance 构成，义为「记忆；纪念」
与 remember 共享拉丁词根 memor，义为「记忆」
由 memor 加 -able 构成，义为「难忘的」

senses.title: To keep something in mind
senses.definition: to have a fact, a name, or an experience stored in your mind and be able to bring it back
senses.definitionCN: 把事实、名字或经历存在心里，并能重新想起来
senses.example: I remember my first day at school very clearly.
senses.exampleCN: 我清楚地记得上学的第一天。
senses.why: The Latin verb rememorari means to be mindful again, so the core image is a stored scene coming back whole.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 rememorari 意为「重新留心」，所以核心画面是储存的场景被完整唤回。

senses.title: To not forget to do something
senses.definition: to keep a future task in mind so that you do not fail to do it
senses.definitionCN: 把将来的任务放在心里，以免忘记去做
senses.example: Remember to lock the door when you leave.
senses.exampleCN: 离开时记得锁门。
senses.why: The stored scene here points forward: keeping a duty in mind until the moment arrives.
senses.whyCN: 这里的记忆指向前方：把职责放在心里，直到该行动的时刻。

senses.title: To send greetings through someone
senses.definition: to ask someone to pass your greetings to another person
senses.definitionCN: 请某人把自己的问候带给另一个人
senses.example: Please remember me to your parents.
senses.exampleCN: 请代我向你父母问好。
senses.why: Holding a person in mind turns into a spoken greeting sent through a third party.
senses.whyCN: 把某人放在心上，就变成托第三个人带去的问候。

senses.title: To honour the memory of someone
senses.definition: to keep the memory of a person or event alive with respect
senses.definitionCN: 怀着敬意让某个人或某件事的记忆继续存在
senses.example: The town holds a service to remember the victims.
senses.exampleCN: 镇上举行仪式纪念遇难者。
senses.why: Keeping a memory is not only recalling it privately but also publicly refusing to let it fade.
senses.whyCN: 让记忆存续不只是私下回想，也是公开地拒绝让它淡去。

intro.en: Remember comes from Old French remembrer, from Latin rememorari, built on re- and memor, mindful.
intro.cn: remember 来自古法语 remembrer，源自拉丁语 rememorari，由 re- 与 memor「留心的、记得的」构成。

items.en: Memor means mindful or remembering, and gives memory, memorial, and memorable.
items.cn: memor 意为「留心的、记得的」，产生了 memory、memorial 与 memorable。

items.en: Rememorari means to recall or call back to mind, adding re- to memor.
items.cn: rememorari 意为回想、重新唤起记忆，在 memor 前加了 re-。

items.en: Remembrer means to recall and also to remind another person.
items.cn: 古法语 remembrer 既表示回想，也表示提醒别人。

items.en: English remember covers recall, keeping a duty in mind, and sending greetings.
items.cn: 英语 remember 覆盖回想、记住职责以及代问好等用法。

items.en: The public sense of honouring the dead grows out of the idea of keeping memory alive.
items.cn: 公开纪念逝者的义项，是从「让记忆继续存在」这一想法发展而来。

note.en: Remember belongs to the memor- family of memory and memorial, and it stands near remind and recall.
note.cn: remember 属于 memory、memorial 所在的 memor- 词族，并与 remind、recall 相邻。

entries.definition: the act of remembering or a thing kept in memory
entries.definitionCN: 记忆；纪念物，由 remember 加 -ance 构成

entries.definition: the ability to remember things
entries.definitionCN: 记忆力；回忆，与 remember 共享 memor 词根

entries.definition: worth remembering because it is special
entries.definitionCN: 难忘的；值得记住的

entries.definition: to bring something back into your mind
entries.definitionCN: 回想起，比 remember 更强调主动调取

entries.definition: to make someone remember something
entries.definitionCN: 提醒；使想起，方向相反

entries.definition: to learn something by heart
entries.definitionCN: 记住；背诵，强调刻意背下来

normalIntro.en: The memor- root of mindful is shared with memory and memorial, so the family is easy to keep together.
normalIntro.cn: 表示「留心」的 memor- 词根与 memory、memorial 共用，整族词很容易一起记。

normal.en: Re- plus memor, mindful, means becoming mindful again of something past.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 memor「留心的」，就是重新对过去的事留心。

normal.en: Remember to do looks forward, while remember doing looks back.
normal.cn: remember to do 指向将来，remember doing 指回过去。

normal.en: The noun remembrance adds -ance to the verb stem.
normal.cn: 名词 remembrance 在动词词干后加 -ance。

normal.en: Please remember me to your parents is a polite, slightly formal request.
normal.cn: 「please remember me to your parents」是礼貌而略正式的请求。

normal.en: Memory and memorable keep the same memor- stem without the re- prefix.
normal.cn: memory 与 memorable 保留同一个 memor- 词干，但不带 re- 前缀。

abstract.en: Picture an old photograph sliding out of a drawer, still sharp in every detail.
abstract.cn: 想象一张旧照片从抽屉里滑出来，每个细节依旧清晰。

abstract.en: See a note tied to a door handle so the task cannot be missed.
abstract.cn: 想象门上系着一张纸条，让任务不会被漏掉。

abstract.en: Think of people standing quietly around a stone with names carved on it.
abstract.cn: 想人们安静地围着一块刻着名字的石头站着。

examples.en: I can't remember where I put the keys.
examples.cn: 我想不起来把钥匙放在哪里了。

examples.en: Remember to switch off the lights before you go.
examples.cn: 走之前记得关灯。

examples.en: The ceremony remembers those who died in the war.
examples.cn: 这场仪式纪念在战争中死去的人们。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞曼伯」——想象瑞丽有位曼伯，能把往事一件件说清楚；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 remembrer，源自拉丁语 rememorari（re-「再次」+ memor「留心的、记得的」）。

sensesIntro.en: Keeping something mindful runs in four directions: what happened, what must be done, who should be greeted, and who must not be forgotten.
sensesIntro.cn: 「把某事放在心上」朝四个方向延伸：发生过什么、要做什么、该向谁问好、以及谁不能被忘记。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a past scene returning with every detail intact.
core.cn: 核心意象：过去的场景带着完整细节重新浮现。

branches.en: Bringing a stored scene back is the central sense.
branches.cn: 把储存的场景重新调出，是这个词的中心义。

branches.en: Holding a future duty in mind points the same verb forward.
branches.cn: 把未来的职责放在心上，使这个动词指向前方。

branches.en: Holding a person in mind becomes a greeting sent through another.
branches.cn: 把某人放在心上，变成托人带去的问候。

branches.en: Publicly keeping a memory alive becomes commemoration.
branches.cn: 公开让记忆存续，就成为纪念。

branches.en: Private recall and public remembrance are two scales of one act.
branches.cn: 私下回想与公开纪念是同一个动作的两个尺度。

intro.en: Remember is a Latin-derived verb with a repeated prefix and a root about being mindful.
intro.cn: remember 是拉丁来源的动词，含表重复的前缀与表示「留心」的词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means again, and memor means mindful, so the verb means to become mindful again.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「再次」，memor 表示「留心的」，动词即「重新留心」。

items.example: Re- marks the return of a memory.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 标记记忆的回返。

items.example: The memor- root also appears in memory.
items.exampleCN: memor- 词根也出现在 memory 中。

items.example: Memor is the adjective behind the whole family.
items.exampleCN: memor 是整族词背后的形容词。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或行为的名词词尾
items.example: Remembrance names the state of keeping someone in mind.
items.exampleCN: remembrance 指把某人放在心上的状态。

items.meaning: to recall, call back to mind
items.example: Rememorari is the direct Latin ancestor.
items.exampleCN: rememorari 是直接的拉丁祖先。

items.example: Memorable means worth remembering.
items.exampleCN: memorable 意为「值得记住的」。

items.example: Memory and remember split the same stem.
items.exampleCN: memory 与 remember 分担同一个词干。

items.meaning: to honour the memory of someone
items.example: Commemorate adds com- to the same memor root.
items.exampleCN: commemorate 在同一个 memor 词根前加了 com-。

难忘的
纪念；缅怀

definition_zh: 提醒；使想起；使联想到
definition_en: to make someone remember something they might forget, or to make them think of it
core_image: 有人轻轻碰一下你的胳膊，指着你差点忘掉的东西
scene: 出门前，母亲在门口叫住他，说下午还有一节牙医预约。As he left, his mother reminded him of the dentist appointment that afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 remind 是「提醒」（第 1 个义项：使某人记起可能会忘的事）；句意：他出门时，母亲提醒他下午还有牙医预约。

pos.zh: 提醒；使想起；使联想到

derivatives.zh: remind 加 -er 构成，义为「提醒；提示物」
remind 的第二成分，义为「心思；头脑」

senses.title: To make someone remember a duty
senses.definition: to tell someone about something they must do or must not forget
senses.definitionCN: 告诉某人必须做或不能忘记的事
senses.example: The nurse reminded him to take his pills after dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 护士提醒他晚饭后吃药。
senses.why: The word is a plain compound of re- and mind, so the picture is putting something back into someone's mind.
senses.whyCN: 这个词就是 re- 与 mind 的简单复合，画面是把某件事重新放进某人的心里。

senses.title: To make someone think of something
senses.definition: to cause someone to remember a person, place, or feeling through similarity
senses.definitionCN: 因相似而使人想起某个人、地方或感觉
senses.example: This song reminds me of my summer in the north.
senses.exampleCN: 这首歌让我想起在北方度过的那个夏天。
senses.why: A sight or sound can put a memory back into the mind without any duty involved, which is this sense.
senses.whyCN: 一个景象或声音可以不经任何职责，就把记忆重新放回心里，这就是第二义项。

intro.en: Remind is an English compound of the prefix re- and the native noun mind, first recorded in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: remind 是英语本土复合词，由前缀 re- 与本土名词 mind 构成，最早见于十七世纪。

items.en: The noun gemynd means memory and mind, and becomes modern English mind.
items.cn: 古英语名词 gemynd 表示记忆与心智，后来演变为现代英语的 mind。

items.en: The prefix re- enters English through French and Latin and means again or back.
items.cn: 前缀 re- 经法语与拉丁语进入英语，表示「再次、回」。

items.en: Remind is formed to mean put a thing back into someone's mind.
items.cn: remind 被构造出来，表示「把某事重新放进某人心里」。

items.en: The pattern remind someone of something becomes established for similarity.
items.cn: 十八世纪，remind someone of something 这一句型固定下来，用于表示相似引起的联想。

items.en: The noun reminder turns the verb into a thing that prompts, such as an alarm or a note.
items.cn: 名词 reminder 把动词变成一个起提示作用的事物，例如闹钟或便条。

note.en: Remind is a native compound whose second half is mind, and it stands opposite remember in direction.
note.cn: remind 是第二个成分 mind 的本土复合词，与 remember 的方向相反。

entries.definition: something that makes you remember
entries.definitionCN: 提醒；提示物，由 remind 加 -er 构成

entries.definition: the part of a person that thinks and remembers
entries.definitionCN: 心智；头脑，是 remind 的第二成分

entries.definition: to keep or bring something into your own mind
entries.definitionCN: 记得；想起，与 remind 拼写相近但方向相反

entries.definition: to cause someone to do or say something
entries.definitionCN: 促使；提示，常用于舞台或软件

entries.definition: to warn someone about a danger or problem
entries.definitionCN: 向……报警；提醒注意，带有警告意味

entries.definition: to push someone gently, often to make them act
entries.definitionCN: 轻推；委婉提醒

normalIntro.en: Remind is simply re- plus mind, so the word means putting something back into a mind.
normalIntro.cn: remind 就是 re- 加 mind，意思是把某件事重新放回心里。

normal.en: Remember is what you do yourself; remind is what someone else does to you.
normal.cn: remember 是自己记得，remind 是别人来提醒你。

normal.en: Add -er for reminder, the thing that does the prompting.
normal.cn: 加 -er 得到 reminder，即起提示作用的事物。

normal.en: Remind someone of takes a noun, while remind someone to takes a verb.
normal.cn: remind sb of 后接名词，remind sb to 后接动词。

normal.en: A calendar alert is a digital reminder in everyday life.
normal.cn: 日历提醒就是日常生活中的数字 reminder。

normal.en: The second half is the native word mind, not the Latin root ment-.
normal.cn: 第二个成分是本土词 mind，而不是拉丁词根 ment-。

abstract.en: Picture a hand tapping your arm just as you reach for the wrong door.
abstract.cn: 想象你正要开错门时，一只手轻轻碰了碰你的胳膊。

abstract.en: See a yellow note stuck to a laptop screen.
abstract.cn: 想象笔记本电脑屏幕上贴着一张黄色便条。

abstract.en: Think of a smell that instantly brings back a kitchen from childhood.
abstract.cn: 想一种气味，瞬间把童年的厨房带回来。

examples.en: Please remind me to call the bank tomorrow.
examples.cn: 请提醒我明天给银行打电话。

examples.en: That photograph reminds her of her grandmother.
examples.cn: 那张照片让她想起她的祖母。

examples.en: The teacher reminded the class about the deadline.
examples.cn: 老师提醒全班注意截止日期。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞曼的」——想象瑞丽那位慢吞吞的人总被人轻轻提醒；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语本土复合词：前缀 re-（再次）加名词 mind（心智、记忆），字面即「重新放入心中」。

sensesIntro.en: Putting something back into a mind covers both a duty that must not be forgotten and a memory stirred by resemblance.
sensesIntro.cn: 把某事重新放进心里，既涵盖不能忘记的职责，也涵盖因相似而被唤起的回忆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a light tap on the arm pointing at something nearly forgotten.
core.cn: 核心意象：有人轻碰你的胳膊，指向你差点忘掉的东西。

branches.en: A duty put back into the mind is the practical everyday sense.
branches.cn: 把职责重新放回心里，是最实际的日常义项。

branches.en: A sight that stirs a memory does the same work without any duty.
branches.cn: 触动记忆的景象做着同样的事，却与职责无关。

branches.en: Both are cases of something returning to mind from outside.
branches.cn: 两者都是某事物从外部回到心里的情形。

branches.en: Repeated reminders turn a prompt into a small warning.
branches.cn: 反复提醒会把提示变成小小的警告。

branches.en: Resemblance is the most common trigger of spontaneous recall.
branches.cn: 相似是最常见的自发回忆触发器。

intro.en: Remind is a rare case of a Latin prefix joined to a native English noun.
intro.cn: remind 是拉丁前缀与英语本土名词结合的少见例子。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, and mind is the native word for the thinking and remembering part of a person.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示「再次」，mind 是英语本族词，指人思考与记忆的部分。

items.example: Re- puts the thing back where it belongs.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 表示把它放回原处。

items.example: Mind is a native word of Germanic origin.
items.exampleCN: mind 是源自日耳曼语的本土词。

items.example: Reminder is the thing that prompts.
items.exampleCN: reminder 是起提示作用的事物。

items.example: Gemynd is the Old English ancestor of mind.
items.exampleCN: gemynd 是 mind 的古英语祖先。

items.meaning: a prompt or a note that reminds
items.example: A reminder can be a sound, a message, or a note.
items.exampleCN: reminder 可以是声音、消息或便条。

items.example: Mindful shows the noun mind with the ending -ful.
items.exampleCN: mindful 展示了名词 mind 加 -ful 的形式。

items.example: Memory is the Latin partner of the native mind.
items.exampleCN: memory 是本土词 mind 的拉丁对应词。

items.meaning: to keep or bring into your own mind
items.example: Remember reverses the direction of remind.
items.exampleCN: remember 与 remind 的方向相反。

留心的；注意的

definition_zh: 抗议；反对；规劝；告诫
definition_en: to protest strongly or to urge someone earnestly to change their behaviour
core_image: 一个人把证据摊在桌上，指着它要求对方收回决定
scene: 几位居民堵在工地门口，向负责人抗议夜间施工的噪音。Several residents remonstrated with the site manager about the noise at night.
sceneCN: 这里 remonstrate 是「抗议、反对」（第 1 个义项：强烈地表达不满）；句意：几位居民就夜间噪音向工地负责人提出抗议。

pos.zh: 抗议；反对；规劝

derivatives.zh: remonstrate 加 -ance 构成，义为「抗议；谏言」
remonstrate 加 -ant 构成，义为「抗议的」

senses.title: To protest strongly
senses.definition: to tell someone forcefully that you think their action is wrong
senses.definitionCN: 有力地告诉对方，你认为其行为是错的
senses.example: The workers remonstrated against the sudden pay cut.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们抗议突然的降薪。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to show back, so the core picture is laying evidence before someone in order to push back.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「反过来展示」，所以核心画面是把证据摆到对方面前以表示反对。

senses.title: To urge someone earnestly to change
senses.definition: to advise someone seriously and at length against a course of action
senses.definitionCN: 认真而持续地劝某人不要走某条路
senses.example: His friends remonstrated with him about leaving school.
senses.exampleCN: 朋友们劝他不要退学。
senses.why: Showing someone the reasons can be aimed at correcting them rather than merely objecting, which gives the advising sense.
senses.whyCN: 把理由摆给对方看，目的可以是纠正而不只是反对，由此生出「规劝」义。

intro.en: Remonstrate comes from Latin remonstrare, to show back, built on re- and monstrare, to show.
intro.cn: remonstrate 来自拉丁语 remonstrare「反过来指明」，由 re- 与 monstrare「展示」构成。

items.en: Monstrare means to show or point out, and gives demonstrate and monster.
items.cn: monstrare 意为展示、指出，产生了 demonstrate 与 monster。

items.en: Remonstrare adds re- and means to show in return or point out in opposition.
items.cn: remonstrare 加 re-，意为反过来指出或以指明的方式反对。

items.en: Remonstrare develops the legal sense of setting out a grievance.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语中，remonstrare 发展出陈述申诉的法律义。

items.en: English remonstrate enters through French with the sense of making a formal protest.
items.cn: 十六世纪，remonstrate 经法语进入英语，带有正式抗议的含义。

items.en: The word splits into the public sense of protest and the private sense of earnest advice.
items.cn: 这个词分成公开抗议与私下规劝两个方向。

note.en: Remonstrate belongs to the monstrare family of showing, and to the vocabulary of protest and advice.
note.cn: remonstrate 属于 monstrare「展示」词族，也属于抗议与规劝的词汇。

entries.definition: a formal protest or complaint
entries.definitionCN: 抗议；谏书，由 remonstrate 加 -ance 构成

entries.definition: to show clearly by giving proof
entries.definitionCN: 证明；演示，与 remonstrate 共享 monstrare 词根

entries.definition: a strange and frightening creature
entries.definitionCN: 怪物，同出 monstrum「被指出之物」，但意义已远离

entries.definition: to say strongly that you disagree with something
entries.definitionCN: 抗议；反对，是最直接的近义词

entries.definition: to say that you disagree or disapprove
entries.definitionCN: 反对；提出异议，语气较弱

entries.definition: to warn or advise someone seriously
entries.definitionCN: 告诫；警告，与第二义项接近

normalIntro.en: The monstr- root of showing links remonstrate with demonstrate, so the word pictures evidence held up.
normalIntro.cn: 表示「展示」的 monstr- 词根把 remonstrate 与 demonstrate 连起来，画面是举起证据。

normal.en: Re- plus monstrare, to show, means showing something back in argument.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 monstrare「展示」，就是把东西反过来展示出来争论。

normal.en: Demonstrate shares the identical monstr- root and means showing forward.
normal.cn: demonstrate 共享完全相同的 monstr- 词根，表示正面展示。

normal.en: The verb is usually followed by with, against, or about.
normal.cn: 这个动词后常接 with、against 或 about。

normal.en: The noun remonstrance adds -ance and often sounds formal or historical.
normal.cn: 名词 remonstrance 加 -ance，常带正式或历史色彩。

normal.en: Remonstrate is stronger and more formal than complain.
normal.cn: remonstrate 比 complain 更强烈、更正式。

abstract.en: Picture a letter of complaint being placed on a manager's desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一封投诉信被放在经理的桌上。

abstract.en: See a crowd standing at a gate with signs held high.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人站在大门口，高举标语。

abstract.en: Think of a friend holding your arm and listing reasons not to leave.
abstract.cn: 想一位朋友拉住你的手臂，一条条列举不该离开的理由。

examples.en: She remonstrated with the driver about the speed.
examples.cn: 她向司机抗议车速太快。

examples.en: The elders remonstrated against closing the village school.
examples.cn: 长辈们反对关闭村里的学校。

examples.en: He was remonstrated with for missing so many meetings.
examples.cn: 他因缺席太多会议而被规劝。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞蒙斯特雷特」——想象瑞丽有人拉着你讲道理，不许你走；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 remonstrare（re-「回、反」+ monstrare「展示」），字面即「反过来指明」，引申为抗议、规劝。

sensesIntro.en: Laying evidence in front of someone can either push back against them or lead them away from a mistake.
sensesIntro.cn: 把证据摆到对方面前，既可以用来抵制对方，也可以用来把对方从错误中引开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: evidence laid on the table and pushed toward the other person.
core.cn: 核心意象：把证据摊在桌上，推对方面前。

branches.en: Showing something back becomes public protest.
branches.cn: 把东西反过来展示，成为公开抗议。

branches.en: Showing reasons can also be an attempt to correct a friend.
branches.cn: 摆出理由也可以是试图纠正朋友。

branches.en: Both senses use evidence, only the goal differs.
branches.cn: 两个义项都用证据，区别只在目的。

branches.en: A public setting makes the protest formal and collective.
branches.cn: 公开场合让抗议变得正式且集体化。

branches.en: A private setting turns the same act into earnest advice.
branches.cn: 私下场合让同一个动作变成恳切规劝。

intro.en: Remonstrate is a Latin verb whose prefix and showing root are both still transparent.
intro.cn: remonstrate 是一个拉丁动词，其前缀与表示「展示」的词根仍然清晰可辨。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means back, and monstrare means to show, so the pair means to show in return.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「回、反」，monstrare 表示「展示」，两者合起来就是「反过来展示」。

items.example: Re- turns the showing into a counter-move.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 把展示变成一种反制动作。

items.example: The monstr- root also appears in demonstrate.
items.exampleCN: monstr- 词根也出现在 demonstrate 中。

items.example: Monstrare is the verb behind the root.
items.exampleCN: monstrare 是这个词根背后的动词。

items.meaning: marks a verb from a stem
items.meaningCN: 由词干构成动词的词尾
items.example: The ending -ate marks the English verb form.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ate 标记英语动词形式。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或行为的名词词尾
items.example: Remonstrance names the act of protesting.
items.exampleCN: remonstrance 指抗议这一行为。

items.example: Remonstrare is the direct Latin source.
items.exampleCN: remonstrare 是直接的拉丁来源。

items.example: Demonstrate adds de- to the same monstr- root.
items.exampleCN: demonstrate 在同一个 monstr- 词根前加了 de-。

items.meaning: a structure that keeps a memory
items.example: Monument comes from monere, a close cousin of monstrare.
items.exampleCN: monument 来自 monere，与 monstrare 是近亲。

derivatives.zh: 抗议；谏言
抗议的

definition_zh: 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的；微小的；远程的
definition_en: far away in distance or time, or not closely connected
core_image: 一条土路通向山后，远处的房子小得只剩一个点
scene: 那里没有公交，最近的诊所也在两个小时车程之外。There is no bus service, and the nearest clinic is two hours away in a remote valley.
sceneCN: 这里 remote 是「偏僻的、遥远的」（第 1 个义项：距离很远）；句意：那里没有公交，最近的诊所位于两个小时车程之外的偏僻山谷。

pos.zh: 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的；微小的；远程的

derivatives.zh: remote 加 -ly 构成，义为「遥远地；丝毫（用于否定）」
remote 加 -ness 构成，义为「遥远；偏僻」
与 remote 同出拉丁语 removere，义为「移开；去除」

senses.title: Far away in space or time
senses.definition: a long way from towns, people, or the present time
senses.definitionCN: 距离城镇、人群或当下时间很远
senses.example: They live in a remote village in the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在山中的偏远村庄里。
senses.why: The Latin participle remotus means moved back, so the core image is something pushed to a distance.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁分词 remotus 意为「被移开的」，所以核心画面是被推到远处的某个东西。

senses.title: Distant in manner
senses.definition: not friendly or close, keeping other people at a distance
senses.definitionCN: 不亲近，把他人挡在一定的距离之外
senses.example: His manner was polite but remote.
senses.exampleCN: 他的态度礼貌，却显得疏远。
senses.why: If something can be moved far away in space, a person can also hold others far away in feeling.
senses.whyCN: 既然东西可以在空间上被推远，人也可以在情感上把别人挡在远处。

senses.title: Very slight or unlikely
senses.definition: existing only in a small amount, so that it is unlikely to happen
senses.definitionCN: 只存在很小的一点，因此不太可能发生
senses.example: There is only a remote possibility of rain this week.
senses.exampleCN: 这周下雨的可能性很小。
senses.why: Distance in space turns into distance in probability: what is far off is unlikely to arrive.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的距离会变成概率上的距离：离得远的东西，就很难真的到来。

senses.title: Operated from a distance
senses.definition: controlled or done from a place that is not the place of action
senses.definitionCN: 在非现场的位置进行控制或操作
senses.example: She works from a remote office two hundred miles away.
senses.exampleCN: 她在两百英里外的远程办公点工作。
senses.why: The plain idea of being far away gives the modern technical sense of working or controlling at a distance.
senses.whyCN: 「处在远处」这个朴素含义，给出了现代远程工作与远程控制的技术义。

intro.en: Remote is the past participle of Latin removere, to move back, which also gives the verb remove.
intro.cn: remote 是拉丁语 removere「移开」的过去分词，同一个动词也产生了 remove。

items.en: Removere joins re- with movere, to move, and means to move back or away.
items.cn: removere 由 re- 与 movere「移动」组合，意为向后移开或移走。

items.en: The participle remotus describes something that has been moved away, hence distant.
items.cn: 分词 remotus 描述被移走的东西，因而表示遥远。

items.en: Movere also gives motion, motive, and mobile, all about movement.
items.cn: movere 还产生 motion、motive、mobile 等词，都与移动有关。

items.en: English remote first means far off in space or time.
items.cn: 英语 remote 最初表示在空间或时间上遥远。

items.en: The word widens to cover an aloof manner, a slight chance, and work done at a distance.
items.cn: 词义扩展到冷淡的态度、微小的可能性以及在远处完成的工作。

note.en: Remote shares its Latin verb with remove, and it stands beside words for distance and for aloofness.
note.cn: remote 与 remove 共享同一个拉丁动词，并与表示距离和冷淡的词相邻。

entries.definition: from a distance, or by even a small amount
entries.definitionCN: 远程地；丝毫（多用于否定），由 remote 加 -ly 构成

entries.definition: to take something away
entries.definitionCN: 移开；去除，与 remote 同出拉丁语 removere

entries.definition: the act of moving
entries.definitionCN: 运动；动作，与 remote 共享 movere 词根

entries.definition: far away in space or time
entries.definitionCN: 遥远的，是最直接的近义词

entries.definition: far from other places or people
entries.definitionCN: 孤立的；偏僻的，强调与外界隔绝

entries.definition: not friendly and deliberately distant
entries.definitionCN: 冷淡的；疏远的，与第二义项接近

normalIntro.en: Remote and remove are twins from the Latin verb removere, so distance and removal sit side by side.
normalIntro.cn: remote 与 remove 是拉丁动词 removere 的双生词，距离与移开因此相邻。

normal.en: Re- plus movere, to move, gives something moved away and therefore far off.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 movere「移动」，就是被移走因而很远的。

normal.en: Remove is the verb, remote the adjective, and remoteness the noun.
normal.cn: remove 是动词，remote 是形容词，remoteness 是名词。

normal.en: The movere root also drives motion, motive, and mobile.
normal.cn: movere 词根也驱动着 motion、motive 与 mobile。

normal.en: Remote control and remote access are the two modern fixed phrases.
normal.cn: remote control 与 remote access 是两个现代固定说法。

normal.en: In the negative, remotely means at all, as in not remotely ready.
normal.cn: 在否定句中，remotely 表示「丝毫」，如 not remotely ready。

abstract.en: Picture a single light on a hillside hours away from the road.
abstract.cn: 想象山坡上一点孤灯，离公路还有几个小时。

abstract.en: See a person answering politely while stepping half a pace back.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人礼貌回答，同时后退半步。

abstract.en: Think of a hand controller working a machine in another room.
abstract.cn: 想一只遥控器在另一个房间操纵机器。

examples.en: The farm is remote and hard to reach in winter.
examples.cn: 这个农场很偏僻，冬天很难到达。

examples.en: There is a remote chance that the letter survived.
examples.cn: 那封信还有极小的可能保存下来。

examples.en: He seemed remote and said almost nothing.
examples.cn: 他显得疏远，几乎什么也没说。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞摩托」——想象骑着摩托在瑞丽山里越走越远；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 remotus，是 removere（re-「向后」+ movere「移动」）的过去分词，字面即「被移远的」。

sensesIntro.en: Being moved far away gives physical distance, emotional distance, small probability, and distance in control.
sensesIntro.cn: 「被移远」既给出物理距离，也给出情感距离、微小的可能性，以及控制上的距离。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a house shrunk to a dot beyond the hill.
core.cn: 核心意象：山那边的房子缩成了一个小点。

branches.en: Physical distance is the base of every other sense.
branches.cn: 物理距离是其他所有义项的基础。

branches.en: Distance in feeling produces the aloof manner.
branches.cn: 情感上的距离产生冷淡的态度。

branches.en: Distance in probability makes a chance remote.
branches.cn: 可能性上的距离使机会变得渺茫。

branches.en: Distance in control gives work and access at a distance.
branches.cn: 控制上的距离产生远程工作与远程访问。

branches.en: All three are the same refusal to be close.
branches.cn: 三者都是同一种「不愿靠近」。

intro.en: Remote is a Latin particle frozen into an English adjective, carrying a prefix and a movement root.
intro.cn: remote 是凝固成英语形容词的拉丁分词，带着前缀与表示移动的词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means back, and movere means to move, so remotus means moved back or away.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「向后」，movere 表示「移动」，因此 remotus 就是「被移开的」。

items.example: Re- gives the direction of the move.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 给出移动的方向。

items.example: The mov- root returns in motion and remove.
items.exampleCN: mov- 词根出现在 motion 与 remove 中。

items.example: Movere is the verb behind the root.
items.exampleCN: movere 是这个词根背后的动词。

items.example: The ending -tus makes remotus a participle.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -tus 使 remotus 成为分词。

items.example: Remotus is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: remotus 是这个英语词的直接来源。

items.example: Remotely adds -ly to the adjective.
items.exampleCN: remotely 在形容词后加了 -ly。

items.example: Remoteness names the quality of being far away.
items.exampleCN: remoteness 指「遥远」这一性质。

items.example: Remove is the verb of the same Latin family.
items.exampleCN: remove 是同一拉丁词族的动词。

definition_zh: 移走；去除；免职；搬迁
definition_en: the act of taking something away or getting rid of it
core_image: 工人把旧招牌从墙上整个卸下来搬走
scene: 装修队第一件事就是把厨房那面旧瓷砖全部拆掉。The first job of the builders was the removal of the old tiles in the kitchen.
sceneCN: 这里 removal 是「拆除、去除」（第 1 个义项：把某物拿走或清除）；句意：装修队的第一项工作就是把厨房的旧瓷砖拆掉。

pos.zh: 移走；去除；免职；搬迁

derivatives.zh: removal 的动词来源，义为「移开；去除」
remove 加 -able 构成，义为「可拆卸的」

senses.title: The act of taking something away
senses.definition: the act of taking a thing from one place and putting it somewhere else or out of the way
senses.definitionCN: 把某物从一处拿走、移到别处或挪开的行为
senses.example: The removal of the old bridge took three months.
senses.exampleCN: 拆除旧桥花了三个月。
senses.why: Removal is simply the noun of remove, so the whole word restates the act of moving something away.
senses.whyCN: removal 就是 remove 的名词，整词只是重述「把东西移走」这个动作。

senses.title: The act of getting rid of something
senses.definition: the process of clearing away dirt, waste, or something unwanted
senses.definitionCN: 清除污渍、废物或不想要之物的过程
senses.example: Stain removal is easiest while the mark is still wet.
senses.exampleCN: 污渍还湿的时候最容易除掉。
senses.why: Taking a thing away and taking a stain away are the same motion, only the thing belongs to the surface.
senses.whyCN: 把东西拿走与把污渍去掉是同一个动作，只是对象附着在表面上。

senses.title: Dismissal from a post
senses.definition: the act of forcing someone out of a job or an official position
senses.definitionCN: 迫使某人离开职位或官方岗位的行为
senses.example: The board voted for the removal of the director.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会投票决定免去这位主管的职务。
senses.why: A person can be moved out of a post just as an object can be moved out of a room.
senses.whyCN: 人也可以像物件一样被移出职位，于是有了免职义。

senses.title: The act of moving to a new home
senses.definition: the process of carrying furniture and belongings to a different house or office
senses.definitionCN: 把家具和物品搬到另一处住宅或办公室的过程
senses.example: The removal to the new flat took a single weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 搬到新公寓只用了一个周末。
senses.why: Moving your own goods away from one address to another is the household version of the same verb.
senses.whyCN: 把自己的家当从一个地址搬到另一个地址，就是同一动词的家庭版。

intro.en: Removal is an English noun formed from the verb remove with the ending -al.
intro.cn: removal 是英语中由动词 remove 加名词词尾 -al 构成的名词。

items.en: Removere, from re- and movere, supplies the base meaning of moving away.
items.cn: 由 re- 与 movere 构成的 removere 提供了「移开」的基础意义。

items.en: Old French remouvoir gives English the verb remove.
items.cn: 古法语 remouvoir 给英语带来动词 remove。

items.en: The verb remove is recorded early in the sense of moving something away.
items.cn: 动词 remove 很早就以「移开某物」的意义被记录。

items.en: The noun removal appears with the ending -al, naming the act rather than the result.
items.cn: 十六世纪出现带 -al 的名词 removal，指行为本身而非结果。

items.en: The word spreads into house moving, waste collection, and dismissal from office.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到搬家、垃圾清运以及免职等领域。

note.en: Removal is the action noun of remove, and it stands beside words for clearing away and for dismissal.
note.cn: removal 是 remove 的动作名词，与表示清除和免职的词相邻。

entries.definition: to take something away
entries.definitionCN: 移开；去除，是 removal 的动词

entries.definition: able to be taken off or out
entries.definitionCN: 可拆卸的；可去除的

entries.definition: a person or firm that moves furniture
entries.definitionCN: 搬家工人或搬家公司，多见于澳大利亚英语

entries.definition: the act of removing written or stored material
entries.definitionCN: 删除，多用于文字与数据

entries.definition: the act of clearing a space of unwanted things
entries.definitionCN: 清理；清除

entries.definition: the act of removing someone from a job
entries.definitionCN: 解雇；免职，与第三义项接近

normalIntro.en: Removal is remove plus the noun ending -al, so every hook starts from the verb.
normalIntro.cn: removal 就是 remove 加名词词尾 -al，所以记忆钩子都从动词出发。

normal.en: Drop the final e of remove and add -al: removal.
normal.cn: 去掉 remove 末尾的 e，加上 -al 就是 removal。

normal.en: The noun names an act, while the verb names the action itself.
normal.cn: 名词指行为过程，动词指去做这个动作。

normal.en: A removal van is the British phrase for a moving truck.
normal.cn: removal van 是英式英语里的「搬家货车」。

normal.en: The movere root of moving is still there under the prefix and endings.
normal.cn: 前缀与词尾之下仍藏着表示「移动」的 movere 词根。

normal.en: In law and politics, removal often means being forced out of office.
normal.cn: 在法律与政治语境中，removal 常指被免职。

abstract.en: Picture a sign being unscrewed and carried off a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一块招牌被拧下螺丝，从墙上搬走。

abstract.en: See a sponge lifting a dark mark off a white shirt.
abstract.cn: 想象海绵把白衬衫上的黑渍吸走。

abstract.en: Think of boxes stacked by a door on moving day.
abstract.cn: 想搬家那天门口堆起的纸箱。

examples.en: The removal of the tree changed the whole garden.
examples.cn: 那棵树被移走后，整个花园都变了样。

examples.en: They booked a removal company for the end of the month.
examples.cn: 他们预订了一家搬家公司，定在月底。

examples.en: The committee demanded the removal of the chairman.
examples.cn: 委员会要求罢免主席。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞木屋」——想象瑞丽的木屋被整间搬走，只剩空地；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 动词 remove 加名词词尾 -al 构成；remove 源自拉丁语 removere（re-「向后」+ movere「移动」）。

sensesIntro.en: One act of moving something away covers objects, dirt, people in posts, and whole households.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个「把东西移走」的动作，涵盖了物件、污垢、职位上的人以及整个家庭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a worn sign unscrewed and carried off the wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧招牌被拧下螺丝，从墙上搬走。

branches.en: The physical taking away is the base act.
branches.cn: 物理上的拿走是基础动作。

branches.en: Clearing dirt away is the same act applied to a surface.
branches.cn: 清除污垢是同一动作施加在表面上。

branches.en: Moving a person out of a post applies it to a job.
branches.cn: 把一个人移出职位，是同一动作施加在岗位上。

branches.en: Moving a household applies it to a whole set of objects.
branches.cn: 搬家把这一动作施加于一整套物品。

branches.en: Both are movement of goods from one place to another.
branches.cn: 两者都是物品从一处到另一处的移动。

intro.en: Removal adds an English noun ending to a Latin-derived verb, so it shows two layers at once.
intro.cn: removal 在拉丁来源的动词上加了英语名词词尾，同时呈现两层来源。

latinIntro.en: The Latin prefix re- and the root movere, to move, still shape the word under its English ending.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 与表示「移动」的词根 movere，在英语词尾之下仍然塑造着这个词。

items.example: Re- marks movement away from a place.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 标记离开某处的移动。

items.example: The mov- root is shared with motion.

items.example: Movere is the verb behind remove.

items.meaningCN: 表示行为或过程的名词词尾
items.example: The ending -al turns remove into an act noun.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -al 把 remove 变成表示行为的抽象名词。

items.example: Removere is the Latin ancestor of the family.
items.exampleCN: removere 是这一词族的拉丁祖先。

items.example: Removable means able to be removed.
items.exampleCN: removable 意为「可以被拆下的」。

items.example: A removable cover makes cleaning easier.
items.exampleCN: 可拆卸的盖子让清洁更方便。

items.example: Motion keeps the plain movere root.
items.exampleCN: motion 保留了朴素的 movere 词根。

可拆卸的；可去除的

definition_zh: 移开；去除；消除；免职；搬迁
definition_en: to take something away from a place or get rid of it
core_image: 把碍事的一把椅子从过道上端走
scene: 医生小心地把纱布揭下来，看了看伤口愈合得怎么样。The nurse carefully removed the bandage to check the wound.
sceneCN: 这里 remove 是「取下、移开」（第 1 个义项：把某物从原处拿走）；句意：护士小心地取下绷带，查看伤口。

pos.zh: 移开；去除；消除；免职；搬迁

derivatives.zh: remove 加 -al 构成，义为「移走；去除」
remove 加 -able 构成，义为「可拆卸的」
remove 加 -ed 构成，义为「远离的；隔代的」

senses.title: To take something away from a place
senses.definition: to lift or carry something out of the place where it was
senses.definitionCN: 把某物从原来的位置搬起或带离
senses.example: Please remove your bag from the seat.
senses.exampleCN: 请把包从座位上拿开。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to move back, so the core image is a thing being moved out of the way.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「向后移」，所以核心画面是东西被移出了原来的位置。

senses.title: To get rid of something
senses.definition: to clean away or put an end to something unwanted
senses.definitionCN: 清除或终结某种不想要的东西
senses.example: This spray removes grease from the oven.
senses.exampleCN: 这种喷剂能去除烤箱上的油污。
senses.why: Once a thing is carried out of the way, it is gone, which is the sense of getting rid of it.
senses.whyCN: 东西一旦被搬到别处就消失了，这正是「去除」义。

senses.title: To dismiss someone from a position
senses.definition: to force a person out of a job or an official role
senses.definitionCN: 迫使某人离开职位或官方岗位
senses.example: The council voted to remove the mayor.
senses.exampleCN: 议会投票决定罢免市长。
senses.why: A person is moved out of a post the way an object is moved out of a room.
senses.whyCN: 人被移出职位，与物件被移出房间是同一个动作。

senses.title: To move to another place
senses.definition: to go with one's household to live somewhere else, in formal or literary use
senses.definitionCN: 带着家当另居他处，属正式或文学性用法
senses.example: The family removed to the countryside in spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人在春天迁往乡下。
senses.why: Moving a whole household away from one address is the same verb applied to people instead of things.
senses.whyCN: 整个家庭从一处住所移走，就是同一个动词用在人而不是物上。

intro.en: Remove comes from Old French remouvoir, from Latin removere, built on re- and movere, to move.
intro.cn: remove 来自古法语 remouvoir，源自拉丁语 removere，由 re- 与 movere「移动」构成。

items.en: Removere means to move back or away, from re- and movere.
items.cn: removere 意为向后移开或移走，由 re- 与 movere 构成。

items.en: Movere is also behind motion, motive, and mobile.
items.cn: movere 也是 motion、motive 与 mobile 的词源。

items.en: Remouvoir means to move away, to take away, and to delay.
items.cn: 古法语 remouvoir 表示移开、拿走以及推迟。

items.en: English remove first covers physical taking away and dismissal from office.
items.cn: 英语 remove 最初同时涵盖物理上的拿开与免职。

items.en: The formal sense of moving house survives mainly in writing and in the adjective removed.
items.cn: 迁居的正式义项主要残存于书面语以及形容词 removed 之中。

note.en: Remove is the verb at the centre of the removal family, and remote is its distant participle.
note.cn: remove 是 removal 词族的中心动词，remote 则是它表示「远方」的分词。

entries.definition: the act of taking something away
entries.definitionCN: 移走；去除，由 remove 加 -al 构成

entries.definition: able to be taken off easily
entries.definitionCN: 可拆卸的，由 remove 加 -able 构成

entries.definition: far away in distance
entries.definitionCN: 遥远的，与 remove 同出拉丁语 removere

entries.definition: to carry something off from where it is
entries.definitionCN: 拿走；带走，口语常用

entries.definition: to remove written or stored material
entries.definitionCN: 删除，多用于文字与数据

entries.definition: to remove completely
entries.definitionCN: 消除；淘汰，语气更强

normalIntro.en: Remove and its family all sit on the movere root of moving things out of the way.
normalIntro.cn: remove 及其词族都立于 movere 词根之上，意为把东西移开。

normal.en: Re- plus movere gives moving something back and out of the way.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 movere，就是把东西往后移开。

normal.en: The adjective removed also means far apart, as in a cousin twice removed.
normal.cn: 形容词 removed 还表示「隔得远」，如 twice removed 指隔两代。

normal.en: Remove a stain and remove doubt work with the same verb but different objects.
normal.cn: remove a stain 与 remove doubt 用同一个动词，只是对象不同。

normal.en: Removal, removable, and remover all build on the verb.
normal.cn: removal、removable、remover 都由这个动词构成。

normal.en: The magnet phrase remove the barrier pairs well with abstract obstacles.
normal.cn: remove the barrier 这个搭配很适合形容抽象障碍。

abstract.en: Picture a chair lifted out of a narrow aisle so people can pass.
abstract.cn: 想象一把椅子被从窄过道端走，人们才能通过。

abstract.en: See a hand peeling a label off a jar.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把标签从罐子上揭下来。

abstract.en: Think of a name being wiped from a list on a board.
abstract.cn: 想黑板名单上的一个名字被擦掉。

examples.en: Please remove your shoes before entering.
examples.cn: 进门前请脱鞋。

examples.en: The new evidence removed all doubt.
examples.cn: 新的证据消除了所有疑问。

examples.en: The judge was removed from the case.
examples.cn: 这位法官被撤出了该案。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞木屋」——想象瑞丽的木屋被整个搬走，地面空了出来；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 remouvoir，源自拉丁语 removere（re-「向后」+ movere「移动」）。

sensesIntro.en: Moving a thing away produces taking away, clearing away, removing a person from a post, and moving house.
sensesIntro.cn: 把东西移开，衍生出拿走、清除、把某人移出职位以及搬家四个义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chair carried out of a narrow aisle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把椅子从窄过道被端走。

branches.en: Carrying a thing away from its place is the base act.
branches.cn: 把东西从原位带走是基础动作。

branches.en: Once carried away, dirt and doubt are gone.
branches.cn: 污垢与疑虑一旦被带走，就消失了。

branches.en: A person can be carried out of a post the same way.
branches.cn: 人也可以用同样方式被带离职位。

branches.en: A household moves itself away from one address.
branches.cn: 家庭把自己从一处住所移走。

branches.en: Physical removal and its result share one motion.
branches.cn: 物理上的移开与它带来的结果共享同一个动作。

intro.en: Remove is a French verb shaped from a Latin prefix and a Latin motion root.
intro.cn: remove 是由拉丁前缀与拉丁移动词根塑造出的法语动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means back and movere means to move, so remove means to move something back or out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「向后」，movere 表示「移动」，因此 remove 意为把东西移开。

items.example: Re- gives the direction of removal.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 给出移开的方向。

items.example: The mov- root is shared with removable.
items.exampleCN: mov- 词根与 removable 共用。

items.example: Movere is the source of motion and motive.
items.exampleCN: movere 是 motion 与 motive 的来源。

items.example: Removal names the act of removing.
items.exampleCN: removal 指「移走」这一行为。

items.example: Removable means able to be taken off.
items.exampleCN: removable 意为「可以被取下的」。

items.example: Removed also means far apart.
items.exampleCN: removed 也表示「相隔很远」。

items.example: Removere is the direct Latin ancestor.
items.exampleCN: removere 是直接的拉丁祖先。

items.example: Mobile keeps the movere root in an adjective.
items.exampleCN: mobile 把 movere 词根保留在形容词中。

definition_zh: 使成为；给予；提供；翻译；演奏
definition_en: to cause something to be in a certain state, or to give or perform something
core_image: 把手里的东西双手递还给对方
scene: 那场事故让他半年不能走路。The accident rendered him unable to walk for six months.
sceneCN: 这里 render 是「使成为」（第 1 个义项：使某物陷入某种状态）；句意：那场事故使他半年不能走路。

pos.zh: 使成为；给予；提供；翻译；演奏

derivatives.zh: render 加 -ing 构成，义为「演绎；译文；渲染」
经法语再借入的形式，义为「演绎；表演版本」
加前缀 sur- 构成，义为「交出；投降」，与 render 同源

senses.title: To cause something to be in a state
senses.definition: to make someone or something be in a particular condition
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或某物处于某种特定状况
senses.example: The flood rendered the road impassable.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水使这条路无法通行。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to give back, and giving a new condition to something is a kind of handing over.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「交还」，而给某物一个新的状态，也是一种交付。

senses.title: To give or provide something
senses.definition: to give help, a service, or a decision in a formal way
senses.definitionCN: 以正式方式给予帮助、服务或作出决定
senses.example: The doctor rendered first aid at the scene.
senses.exampleCN: 医生在现场施行了急救。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply giving, which survives in formal phrases about services and verdicts.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的一层就是「给」，这一点在关于服务和裁决的正式说法中保留下来。

senses.title: To express in another language or form
senses.definition: to put a text or an idea into another language or another medium
senses.definitionCN: 把文本或想法转换成另一种语言或媒介
senses.example: The poem is hard to render into English.
senses.exampleCN: 这首诗很难译成英语。
senses.why: Giving back the meaning of a text in another tongue is a giving in the same old sense.
senses.whyCN: 用另一种语言把文本的意义交出来，仍是那个古老的「给」。

senses.title: To perform or play something
senses.definition: to perform a piece of music, a role, or an interpretation
senses.definitionCN: 演奏一段音乐、扮演一个角色或作出一种演绎
senses.example: She rendered the song with great tenderness.
senses.exampleCN: 她非常温柔地演绎了这首歌。
senses.why: A performance gives the work back to the audience in the performer's own form.
senses.whyCN: 表演是演奏者用自己的形式把作品交还给观众。

intro.en: Render comes from Old French rendre, from Latin reddere, to give back, built on red- and dare, to give.
intro.cn: render 来自古法语 rendre，源自拉丁语 reddere「交还」，由 red- 与 dare「给」构成。

items.en: Dare means to give, and is also behind data, the things given.
items.cn: dare 意为「给」，也是 data（被给出的东西）的词源。

items.en: Reddere adds red- to dare and means to give back or hand over.
items.cn: reddere 在 dare 前加 red-，意为交还或交出。

items.en: Rendre means to give back, to yield, and to translate.
items.cn: 古法语 rendre 表示交还、让与以及翻译。

items.en: English render covers giving, causing a state, and expressing in another form.
items.cn: 英语 render 涵盖给予、使处于某种状态以及以另一种形式表达。

items.en: The word keeps a formal tone in phrases about services, verdicts, and translations.
items.cn: 这个词在涉及服务、裁决与翻译的说法中保持正式语气。

note.en: Render comes from the same Latin giving verb as surrender, and it stands near words for giving and for translation.
note.cn: render 与 surrender 出自同一个拉丁「给」的动词，并与表示给予和翻译的词相邻。

entries.definition: a performance, translation, or version of something
entries.definitionCN: 演绎；译文；版本，由 render 加 -ing 构成

entries.definition: a particular performance of a song or role
entries.definitionCN: 演绎；表演版本，经法语再次借入的形式

entries.definition: to give up or hand over
entries.definitionCN: 交出；投降，与 render 同出拉丁语 reddere

entries.definition: to give something that is needed
entries.definitionCN: 提供；供给，与第二义项接近

entries.definition: to cause something to become
entries.definitionCN: 使成为，与第一义项接近

entries.definition: to express words in another language
entries.definitionCN: 翻译，与第三义项接近

normalIntro.en: The Latin base means to give back, so the hooks all picture handing something over.
normalIntro.cn: 拉丁词根意为「交还」，所以记忆钩子都在想象把东西递过去。

normal.en: Red- plus dare, to give, gives give back, which grows into give and make.
normal.cn: red- 加 dare「给」，就是「交还」，再发展为给予与使成为。

normal.en: Surrender is the same verb with a different prefix, so both hand something over.
normal.cn: surrender 是同一个动词换了个前缀，两者都是把东西交出去。

normal.en: Render a service, render a verdict, and render assistance are formal fixed phrases.
normal.cn: render a service、render a verdict、render assistance 都是正式固定说法。

normal.en: The pattern render plus object plus adjective is common: render it useless.
normal.cn: render 加宾语加形容词的句型很常见：render it useless。

normal.en: Rendering and rendition both name a version of a work.
normal.cn: rendering 与 rendition 都指作品的某个版本。

abstract.en: Picture both hands holding an object out to another person.
abstract.cn: 想象双手把一件东西捧到对方面前。

abstract.en: See a translator turning a page of poetry into another language.
abstract.cn: 想象译者把一页诗变成另一种语言。

abstract.en: Think of a pianist giving a piece back to a silent room.
abstract.cn: 想一位钢琴家把一首曲子交还给安静的房间。

examples.en: The storm rendered the bridge unsafe.
examples.cn: 暴风雨使这座桥变得不安全。

examples.en: Volunteers rendered help to the injured.
examples.cn: 志愿者向伤者提供了帮助。

examples.en: The novel has been rendered into twelve languages.
examples.cn: 这部小说已被译成十二种语言。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「软的」——想象把软软的东西双手递过去，这就是「给予」；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 rendre，源自拉丁语 reddere（red-「回」+ dare「给」），核心为「交还、给出」。

sensesIntro.en: Handing something over grows into giving help, giving a thing a new condition, giving a text a new language, and giving a work a performance.
sensesIntro.cn: 「把东西交出」长成四个方面：给出帮助、给事物一个新状态、给文本一种新语言、给作品一次演绎。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something held out in both hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：双手把东西递到对方面前。

branches.en: Giving a thing a condition is the most abstract form of handing over.
branches.cn: 给事物一个状态，是「交出」最抽象的形式。

branches.en: Giving help or a verdict is the plainest survival of the old sense.
branches.cn: 给予帮助或作出裁决，是古义最朴素的留存。

branches.en: Giving the meaning in another language is translation.
branches.cn: 用另一种语言把意义交出来，就是翻译。

branches.en: Giving a work back as sound or action is performance.
branches.cn: 把作品以声音或动作交还，就是演绎。

branches.en: Both are acts of formal delivery to another party.
branches.cn: 两者都是向另一方正式交付的行为。

intro.en: Render carries a Latin prefix and the Latin verb for giving, reshaped by French.
intro.cn: render 携带拉丁前缀与表示「给」的拉丁动词，并经过法语改造。

latinIntro.en: Latin red- means back, and dare means to give, so reddere means to give back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 red- 表示「回」，dare 表示「给」，因此 reddere 意为「交还」。

items.example: Red- marks the returning of what is given.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 red- 标记所给之物的回返。

items.example: The da- root also appears in data.
items.exampleCN: da- 词根也出现在 data 中。

items.example: Dare is the oldest layer of the word.
items.exampleCN: dare 是这个词最古老的一层。

items.example: Rendre ends in -re, which becomes -er in English.
items.exampleCN: rendre 以 -re 结尾，进入英语后写作 -er。

items.example: Reddere is the direct Latin source.
items.exampleCN: reddere 是直接的拉丁来源。

items.meaningCN: 表示行为或结果的名词词尾
items.example: Rendering names a version or an act of rendering.
items.exampleCN: rendering 指某个版本或演绎行为。

items.example: Surrender means to hand over completely.
items.exampleCN: surrender 意为彻底交出。

items.example: Data is the plural of the Latin word for given things.
items.exampleCN: data 是拉丁语「被给出之物」的复数。

definition_zh: 重新开始；续订；延长；更新；恢复
definition_en: to begin something again, or to make something valid or fresh once more
core_image: 枯枝上重新冒出的一层新绿
scene: 护照还有一个月到期，他赶在出发前去重新办理。His passport expires next month, so he went to renew it before the trip.
sceneCN: 这里 renew 是「续办、延期」（第 2 个义项：延长证件的有效期）；句意：他的护照下个月到期，所以出发前去续办了。

pos.zh: 重新开始；续订；延长；更新；恢复

derivatives.zh: renew 加 -al 构成，义为「更新；续订」
renew 加 -able 构成，义为「可再生的；可续期的」
renew 加 -ed 构成，义为「重新焕发的」

senses.title: To begin something again
senses.definition: to start an activity or a relationship again after a pause
senses.definitionCN: 在停顿之后重新开始某项活动或关系
senses.example: The two countries agreed to renew talks next month.
senses.exampleCN: 两国同意下月重启谈判。
senses.why: The word is simply re- plus new, so the core image is something old putting out fresh growth.
senses.whyCN: 这个词就是 re- 加 new，所以核心画面是旧枝上重新长出新芽。

senses.title: To extend something that expires
senses.definition: to arrange for a document, contract, or subscription to stay valid for longer
senses.definitionCN: 安排证件、合同或订阅继续有效更长时间
senses.example: She renewed her library books online.
senses.exampleCN: 她在网上续借了图书馆的书。
senses.why: Making a thing new again in time is the administrative version of the same renewal.
senses.whyCN: 在时间上让某物重新变新，就是行政意义上的续期。

senses.title: To replace with something new
senses.definition: to put a new part or version in place of an old one
senses.definitionCN: 用新的部件或版本替换旧的
senses.example: The old pipes were renewed last summer.
senses.exampleCN: 旧管道去年夏天全部换新了。
senses.why: The plain sense of making new becomes physical replacement in buildings and equipment.
senses.whyCN: 「使变新」在建筑与设备上落实为实物的更换。

senses.title: To restore strength or feeling
senses.definition: to give someone fresh energy, hope, or confidence
senses.definitionCN: 给某人新的精力、希望或信心
senses.example: A short rest renewed his confidence.
senses.exampleCN: 短暂的休息让他重拾信心。
senses.why: A tired body or a low spirit can also be made new, which is the emotional sense.
senses.whyCN: 疲惫的身体或低落的心情同样可以「变新」，这就是精神层面的义项。

intro.en: Renew is an English formation of re- and the native adjective new, first recorded in the late fourteenth century.
intro.cn: renew 是英语中由前缀 re- 与本土形容词 new 构成的词，最早见于十四世纪晚期。

items.en: The adjective niwe means new, and becomes modern English new.
items.cn: 古英语形容词 niwe 意为「新的」，后来演变为现代英语的 new。

items.en: The parallel French verb renouveler may have supported the English formation.
items.cn: 法语中平行的动词 renouveler 可能对英语构词起了推动作用。

items.en: Renew first means to resume or begin again.
items.cn: renew 最初意为恢复或重新开始。

items.en: The word extends to replacing worn parts and to extending documents in time.
items.cn: 词义扩展到更换磨损部件以及延长文书的有效期。

items.en: Renewable becomes a key word for energy sources that nature replaces.
items.cn: renewable 成为指代自然界可再补充的能源的关键词。

note.en: Renew is a transparent compound of re- and new, and it stands near words for restoring and for extending.
note.cn: renew 是 re- 与 new 的透明复合词，与表示恢复和延长的词相邻。

entries.definition: the act of making something new or valid again
entries.definitionCN: 更新；续订，由 renew 加 -al 构成

entries.definition: able to be replaced naturally or extended
entries.definitionCN: 可再生的；可续期的

entries.definition: recently made or not existing before
entries.definitionCN: 新的，是 renew 的本土词根

entries.definition: to bring something back to an earlier good state
entries.definitionCN: 恢复；修复，强调回到原状

entries.definition: to make something last longer
entries.definitionCN: 延长，与第二义项接近

entries.definition: to begin again after a break
entries.definitionCN: 重新开始；继续，与第一义项接近

normalIntro.en: Renew is re- plus the native word new, which makes the meaning almost visible.
normalIntro.cn: renew 就是 re- 加本土词 new，意思几乎一眼可见。

normal.en: Re- plus new means to make new again, in time, in matter, or in spirit.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 new，就是在时间、物质或精神上重新变新。

normal.en: Add -al for renewal and -able for renewable.
normal.cn: 加 -al 得 renewal，加 -able 得 renewable。

normal.en: Renewable energy is energy that nature keeps replacing.
normal.cn: renewable energy 指自然界不断补充的能源。

normal.en: Renew a passport, a contract, and a subscription are the three practical collocations.
normal.cn: renew a passport、renew a contract、renew a subscription 是三个实用搭配。

normal.en: The past participle renewed often works as an adjective meaning fresh again.
normal.cn: 过去分词 renewed 常用作形容词，表示「重新焕发的」。

abstract.en: Picture green shoots pushing out of a bare branch in spring.
abstract.cn: 想象春天枯枝上冒出嫩绿的新芽。

abstract.en: See a stamped page in a passport being replaced by a new one.
abstract.cn: 想象护照上一页印章被换成了新的一页。

abstract.en: Think of a tired runner standing up after a cup of water.
abstract.cn: 想一位疲惫的跑者喝完一杯水后重新站起。

examples.en: We need to renew the lease before June.
examples.cn: 我们得在六月之前续签租约。

examples.en: The rain renewed the garden after a dry month.
examples.cn: 干旱一个月后，这场雨让花园重新焕发生机。

examples.en: They met again and renewed their friendship.
examples.cn: 他们再次相见，重续了友谊。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞牛」——想象瑞丽的牛经过一冬又长出新毛，焕然一新；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语本土构词：前缀 re-（再次）加形容词 new（新的），字面即「使重新变新」。

sensesIntro.en: Making something new again applies to time, to a document, to worn material, and to a tired spirit.
sensesIntro.cn: 「使重新变新」分别施加于时间、文书、磨损的材料以及疲惫的精神。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fresh green shoots on a bare branch.
core.cn: 核心意象：枯枝上重新冒出的新绿。

branches.en: Starting again after a pause is the temporal sense.
branches.cn: 停顿之后重新开始，是时间层面的义项。

branches.en: Pushing an expiry date forward is renewal in administration.
branches.cn: 把有效期往后推，是行政层面的更新。

branches.en: Swapping old parts for new is renewal in matter.
branches.cn: 用新部件换掉旧的，是物质层面的更新。

branches.en: Refilling energy or hope is renewal in spirit.
branches.cn: 重新注入精力或希望，是精神层面的更新。

branches.en: Both restart something that had stopped or faded.
branches.cn: 两者都让已经停下或消退的东西重新开始。

intro.en: Renew is one of the clearest prefix-plus-word compounds in English, with a Latin prefix on a native base.
intro.cn: renew 是英语中最清晰的「前缀加单词」复合词之一，拉丁前缀加在本土词根上。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, and new is the native English adjective for something recently made.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示「再次」，new 是英语本族形容词，表示「新近形成的」。

items.example: Re- repeats the making of something new.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 表示把「变新」再做一次。

items.example: New is the native base of the whole word.
items.exampleCN: new 是整个词的本土基础。

items.example: Niwe is the Old English form of new.
items.exampleCN: niwe 是 new 的古英语形式。

items.example: Renewal names the act of renewing.
items.exampleCN: renewal 指「更新」这一行为。

items.example: Renewable means able to be renewed.
items.exampleCN: renewable 意为「可以被更新的」。

items.example: Renewed confidence is confidence that has come back.
items.exampleCN: renewed confidence 指重新回来的信心。

items.meaning: the process of making new again
items.example: Urban renewal reshapes old districts.
items.exampleCN: urban renewal 指旧城区的改造复兴。

items.example: Renouveler is the parallel French formation.
items.exampleCN: renouveler 是法语中平行的构词。
